headline: Bay Minette commissioning and volume recovery awaited

highlights: With Oswego operations gradually ramping up, tariff-related costs expected to moderate and Bay Minette potentially starting H1FY28, we expect a gradual improvement in volumes and profitability through FY27.
Thus, we retain BUY, with a TP of INR 1,200, based on 7x FY28E EV/EBITDA.
In-line performance; core EBITDA/t remain above USD 500 mark Novelis’ Q2FY27 adjusted EBITDA came at USD 508mn (+20%/-2%, YoY/QoQ) with EBITDA/t rising 23% YoY to USD 553 (-2% QoQ).
Management expects positive FCF in Q4FY27, supported by ~USD 300mn WC release, insurance recoveries and lower capex.
valuation: Thus, we retain BUY, with a TP of INR 1,200, based on 7x FY28E EV/EBITDA.

Novelis has achieved over USD 240mn in annualised cost savings and targets USD 300mn by FY27-end and USD 350–400mn by FY28-end, driven by SG&A efficiencies, operational improvements and technology-led productivity gains.
Positive FCF is targeted in Q4FY27, supported by ~USD 300mn working capital release and insurance recoveries of ~USD 900mn by FY27-end (USD 1.3bn total).
watch: Key monitorable include Bay Minette ramp-up, customer qualification, tariff mitigation, scrap spreads, working capital normalisation and timely insurance collections Maintain BUY with a TP of INR 1,200 valuing it at 7x FY28E EV/EBITDA.
Key risk • Scrap spreads to remain very high due to tariff impact. • LME aluminium improving sharply.
